messages:
alisa: Heads up — master CI red on integration-tests after lockfile regen. Failing test looks like redis connection errors in test_redis_cache::test_expiry.
ci-bot: Job integration-tests #842 failed: pytest -k test_redis_cache — https://ci.company/845/jobs/842 (logs attached) :rotating_light:
ben: ugh, I saw a bunch of lockfile-related bumps this morning. Any idea which dep changed?
devops-jay: can you paste the failing snippet? might be a transitive bump to redis/aioredis/connection-pool behavior.
maya: grabbing logs now, running locally with the new lock. quick paste: 
```
E   redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to 127.0.0.1:6379. Connection refused.
>       await conn.connect()
E   during setup of test
```
maya: The test spins up a redis container in the runner; connection refused looks like the test container died or the client closed sockets early. Locally I can repro when I pin redis-py==4.8.0 but green on 4.5.3.
ben: interesting — which package bumped us to 4.8.0? can you run `pipdeptree` or `poetry show --tree` to see the chain?
maya: ran `poetry show --tree | sed -n '1,80p'` — looks like `aioredis` -> `redis` bumped via `some-lib` in the new lock (transitive).
devops-jay: please open a quick bisect PR? if it's a transitive change we should either pin a compatible redis version in constraints or revert the lockfile bump until we can validate.
alisa: I can open the PR to pin redis to 4.5.3 in constraints.txt. Ben/Maya can you review? I'll add a note to roll back the lock regen commit in the PR description.
ben: +1 to pin for now. Also can we add a flaky marker to that test to avoid blocking rolling deploys while we investigate deeper?
maya: I think it's a semantic change in connection timeouts in 4.8.0 — I'll run a minimal repro and file an issue upstream. For now pin + flaky marker sounds fine.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by alisa — integration-tests #843 queued.
ci-bot: Integration-tests #843 started — runner-23.
ci-bot: Integration-tests #843 finished: some tests passed, but same redis test still failing on runner-23.
devops-jay: OK keeping this thread here. Alisa — when you open the PR, include `git bisect` notes / commands you used so we can reproduce. If anyone on-call wants to try a local revert of the lock commit, that would help narrow it down faster.
alisa: Will do. Opening PR now with pin + short test skip, and linking to this thread. Thanks all :heart:
